title: The Claude gate-write guard is bypassed after an "accept for session" switches the CLI to acceptEdits
outcome: A Claude session whose user accepted an edit "for the session" (SetPermissionMode acceptEdits) cannot write into a creditable, unsettled gate's worktree unseen: either the guard still sees those writes, or the doc names this path explicitly as uncovered.
acceptance: The Claude gate-write guard is bypassed after an "accept for session" switches the CLI to acceptEdits is done
